title: Add Cross-phase dependencies blocks per phase
objective: Make every cross-phase dependency edge explicit in recovery_plan_latex_contract.md so Plan-2-Tasks does not have to infer them from prose, and so unblocking logic in the tracker is unambiguous.

plan_assets.asset_description: Cross-phase dependencies block template (this phase blocks / blocked by lists)
Concrete cross-phase edges authored from the dependency audit

scope: Insert one '### Cross-phase dependencies' subsection per phase in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md
Place each subsection at the end of the phase, before the 'Exit criteria' heading
implementation_steps: For each phase 1..7, locate the 'Exit criteria' heading (or end of phase if missing)
Insert the '### Cross-phase dependencies' subsection just before it
Populate 'This phase blocks' and 'This phase is blocked by' from amendment 5's edge list
Use canonical task IDs (P<phase>-<seq>) — never legacy IDs
Confirm the edges are consistent with the Blocked by columns produced by P1-3
deliverables: Seven Cross-phase dependencies subsections in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md
Edge lists match the canonical IDs declared in P1-3's action-item tables
acceptance_criteria: Every IDs listed match the regex P[1-7]-[0-9]+
No edge contradicts the Blocked by column from P1-3 (no A blocks B while B's row says blocked-by ≠ A)

cases: Each phase has exactly one Cross-phase dependencies block
Edges consistent with action-item table columns

risks: Edges in amendment 5 reference task IDs that P1-3 may number differently if a new task is added mid-phase — mitigated by completing P1-3 first and harvesting the canonical IDs from there
completion_notes: Added 7 Cross-phase dependencies subsections (one per phase) with canonical IDs only; edges cross-checked against action-item table Blocked-by columns; test_p1_5 passes 3/3.
